findings: Hardcoded chart headings — 'Commandes par heure (aujourd'hui)', 'Commandes par statut (7 derniers jours)', and 'Commandes par heure de la journée ({range}j)' in AdminDashboard and Reports are not translated. Add i18n keys and replace with t(...) calls.
Hardcoded password-reset label — UserForm's reset button renders bare French strings with no i18n keys. Add keys under user.form.resetPassword and user.form.resetSent.
Demo passwords in client bundle — seedAccounts.ts ships Admin2024!, Serveur2024!, Cuisine2024! in the browser bundle. Move to a server-side script or Cloud Function, or strip from production builds.

Secondary-app leak under concurrent submission — UserForm.handleCreate reuses an existing secondary app instance instead of deleting it first, risking a race on double-click. Mirror the seedAccounts pattern: always deleteApp before initializeApp.

Missing Firestore composite index — where('createdAt', '>=') + orderBy('createdAt') requires a composite index. Without it queries fail at runtime. Add to firestore.indexes.json or create in the Firebase console.
